contentPattern.structure: repeating question header + expandable answer panel

suitableFor: collapsible/expandable content sections where users toggle to reveal detail
compact stacks of related topics that benefit from progressive disclosure
notSuitableFor: tabbed content switchers where one panel is visible at a time (use tabs)
always-visible content that does not need toggling (use default content)

distinctFrom.accordion: Vanilla Block Collection 'accordion' is the base; accordion-faq is the WKND FAQ-styled variant (light color scheme, no images, 7 Q&A items). No local accordion block existed prior to this migration, so a new variant was created from the vanilla accordion rather than reusing an existing one.
distinctFrom.tabs-detail / tabs-listing: Those tabs variants show one panel at a time via a tab strip. accordion-faq stacks all question headers vertically and lets multiple/none be expanded independently — the correct pattern for a Q&A list.
